records.name: Duelist Einerseits
records.biography_en: Never meets a counterargument he cannot take personally. His HyperNorm rapier answers every opposing premise with another point. A dissonant card wonders whether listening could count as a parry. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Gegenstand wurde zur persönlichen Gegenrede zugelassen.

variant_notes.note_en: Never meets a counterargument he cannot take personally.

records.name: Rangerin Bildspur
records.biography_en: Can track a meaning much further than its author intended. Her HyperNorm map follows meanings beyond the official edge of the story. A dissonant card asks whether the author has to come along. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Spur führt über die beabsichtigte Bedeutung hinaus.

variant_notes.note_en: Can track a meaning much further than its author intended.

records.name: Logikmönch Folgerichtig
records.biography_en: Accepts the conclusion reluctantly and the premises under protest. His HyperNorm beads count conclusions while the square tile guards the premises. A dissonant card notices one resident has been rounded away. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Folgerung gilt vorbehaltlich ihrer Voraussetzungen.

variant_notes.note_en: Accepts the conclusion reluctantly and the premises under protest.

records.name: Rhetorikhexe Wohlklang
records.biography_en: Makes the last word sound like everyone's favourite first thought. Her HyperNorm horn gives every last word the warmth of an invitation. A dissonant card waits to hear whether anybody may answer. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Schlusswort wurde als allgemeiner Wunsch vorgetragen.

variant_notes.note_en: Makes the last word sound like everyone's favourite first thought.

records.name: Ethikdruide Abwägung
records.biography_en: Can feel the weight of both sides long after the meeting ends. His two acorns balance a HyperNorm judgement that still leaves somebody hurt. A dissonant card asks what the pans cannot hold. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Waage stimmt. Die Sache drückt dennoch.

variant_notes.note_en: Can feel the weight of both sides long after the meeting ends.

records.name: Mythenwecker Nachleben
records.biography_en: Brings old stories back because nobody has finished arguing with them. His chained HyperNorm storybook keeps old explanations from wandering away. A dissonant card asks whether a story might rest without being forgotten. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Nachleben setzt die noch offene Aussprache fort.

variant_notes.note_en: Brings old stories back because nobody has finished arguing with them.
